description: Cancels a created or authorized session, releasing the hold: POST /v1/sessions/:id/cancel. The session moves to state 'cancelled' and nothing can be captured afterwards. Destructive: cancelling an authorized session the seller expected to capture may leave an unpaid consumption — prefer letting the ttl expire when the seller still needs to capture.
name: phantom_cancel_session

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Cancel a payment session
